title: Answer: life is a passage from physical order to mental originality

statements.text: Life is a passage from physical order to mental originality, and from that to canalized mental originality. All the life in the body is the life of its cells, and the line between living and non-living occasions is not sharp.

sources.quote: Thus life is a passage from physical order to pure mental originality, and from pure mental originality to canalized mental originality.
All the life in the body is the life of the individual cells.
